analysis.title: PrimeView (Recap): Thursday Broadly Risk Off; Pain Driven by AI Beta, Only 7th Lgst Degross
key_insights: Thursday 11/5 was the largest tech sell-off since Covid, but not in terms of hedge fund flows. Hedge fund sells outweighed buys almost 6x and HFs cut 1.1std of US gross, the 7th largest degross day since 1 Oct.
For comparison, Oct 28 was a -2.3std degross day, Oct 29 was -2.1std and Oct 21 was -2.2std.
US selling was driven by broader AI-related beta (macro, trend-following systematics, retail) rather than cuts to favoured single-stock trades by equity L/S funds.
Attribution analysis shows hedge funds made money on relative trades within pockets (Neoclouds, Optical & Networking) even though the overall baskets fell sharply.
Aggregate performance estimates for the US: Equity L/S managers +27bps and quants -49bps. The crowded long-short trade was up 2.5% intraday at peak and closed up 1.2%.
US selling was concentrated in crowded AI Winners (-1.1std), Crowded Longs (-0.9std) and Hyperscalers (-1.2std). Semis long selling was moderate (-0.4std).

Flows were muted in Memory names despite a -16.6% move, and muted in Hardware. UBS says hedge funds have de-risked the AI value chain since the summer and now focus on single-stock relative value within AI.
The most liquid names were cut in the de-risking rather than the most crowded, consistent with UBS's earlier deleveraging analysis.
Buy flow was weak. US Pharma was the most bought US sector at +2std but only +13bps in absolute terms.
In Europe, hedge fund flows skewed to buying (+0.9std long buying), concentrated in dip-buying in Banks (+2.6std) and Autos (+3.0std).
Intraday in Europe, Reinsurance is down significantly, but crowded longs are outperforming shorts in Reinsurance by 2.5% (crowding t-stat of 12). L/S funds in Airlines are down 76bps (t-stat 3.7).
Quant strategies posted losses globally on Thursday.
US week-to-date: High Momentum was the most sold factor (-0.4std) and Crowded Longs were similarly de-risked. Hedge funds took -1.8std of profits in US Materials.
AI Resilient and AI Geared Software were the most bought US segment this week (+0.8std). Hedge funds have bought heavily since September as the Software vs Semis negative correlation held.
In Europe this week, Crowded Longs were the most sold (-0.9std), concentrated in Quality names (-1.2std). Energy exposure fell a further -2.5std and Renewables were sold a further -1.7std.
Renewables remain a UBS Equity Strategy and UBS Macro Equity Strategy top pick (long ENGIE and Iberdrola).

In Japan, hedge funds were net sold -110bps week-to-date, driven by de-risking into the US midterm elections. The UBS Deleveraging Indicator for Japan equity L/S switched on at the start of the week and remains on. The quant indicator is off.
Japan Consumer Discretionary was the most bought sector (+50bps WTD) as funds rotated into rate-sensitive and value consumer trades in place of the AI trade.
Japan Info Tech was net sold -1.1std Monday and -1.8std Thursday, -1.7% WTD, driven by the broad-based AI unwind.
